Build passes clean, exit 0.

Fixed two real bugs the dep bump exposed (the rest was just deprecation-warning noise):

1. `src/core/options.js:6` — bundler now hands `{ retryCount }`, code still read `options.retries` (undefined), crashing on `.toFixed()`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`, but the check only handled `true`/`false` explicitly and threw otherwise.

Next: `node build.js` to see the clean run yourself.
